cohort: 495 laboring women with a gestational age greater than 40 weeks treated at Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar, Pakistan from September 2017 to September 2019.
finding: Meconium stained liquor was frequent (67.47%) in post-term pregnancies.
mod_finding: The presence of meconium and fetal distress led to a high rate of cesarean deliveries (64%).
